symptom: Repair v13 passed the candidate static chain and isolated validate-candidates, and it restored CowardBot to the low-skill target band at 33.3%. Idle, Random, Coward, Kite, Tank, BossHunter, ZoneControl, and Route were inside their target bands. GreedyXpBot remained at 0.0%, below the 25%-55% mid-skill target.
root_cause: v13 kept the full v11 sprinkle-spitter XP recovery while restoring v10 projectile timing and spread. The result matched v11 for Greedy, which rules out the projectile timing/spread change as the primary cause. Greedy still dies around 225-229 seconds at levels 8-10, so the likely issue is that the high-XP ranged enemy changes Greedy's 210-300 second route economy without giving enough survivability before the pressure spike.
fix: Do not promote v13 or run the 10-seed expansion. The next repair should test whether Greedy needs a stronger reward conversion rather than a lower reward: raise sprinkle-spitter XP within the special-enemy budget so Greedy can reach the next upgrade threshold before the 225-229 second failure window, while watching Coward and high-skill bots for overperformance. Avoid changing wave composition or player weapon/passive balance until this reward-threshold hypothesis is tested.
validation: Create v14 as a generated candidate only, rerun the full candidate static chain, then rerun the same 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix. Passing requires CowardBot 10%-35%, GreedyXpBot 25%-55%, RouteBot 10%-35%, and all other bots remaining in their configured target bands before any 10-seed expansion.
